name: Broad-Crested
description: A broad-crested weir is a flat-crested structure where the length of the crest is greater than the thickness of the overflowing nappe.

name: Ogee
description: An ogee spillway has an S-shaped curve that follows the lower surface of an aerated nappe flowing over a sharp-crested weir.

name: Specified
description: A spillway with specified characteristics based on project requirements.

name: Gated
description: A spillway equipped with gates to control the flow of water.
